clue.text: Sweet Dalmatian

definitions.meaning: a sweet is a pudding; this one is a suet pudding studded with currants
a Dalmatian is a dog breed with a white coat marked by black spots

explanation.definitionFit: Spotted dick-style suet pudding with currants goes by this name, and a Dalmatian is literally a dog covered in spots.

clue.text: Prudish couple I am supporting

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits beneath, so the contraction comes after the pair

parts.note: PR is the abbreviation of pair, a couple
I am contracts to I'm

explanation.surface: A strait-laced pair, with me holding them up.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone stiffly proper and easily shocked by impropriety.

clue.text: Manufactory of tooled steel in Spain

indicators.note: a manufactory makes things, so the letters of the following word are made into something new

explanation.surface: A Spanish works producing finely tooled steel.
explanation.walkthrough: The city's famous blades were simply called by its name, so the place name doubles as a word for a sword of Spanish steel.
explanation.definitionFit: Swords forged in this Castilian city were so prized that the city's name became a word for such a blade.

clue.text: Old Palestinian fighters about to look for new country

parts.note: ex- means former, old
PLO is the Palestine Liberation Organization
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Former guerrillas set out to seek a fresh homeland.
explanation.definitionFit: To travel into unknown territory in search of new lands is the classic sense of the verb.

clue.text: Welshman left an Irish house

parts.note: Dai is a stock Welsh man's name, short for David

explanation.surface: A Welshman walked out of an Irish home.
explanation.definitionFit: The lower chamber of the Irish parliament is so named, house meaning a legislative assembly.

clue.text: Go on! Beat it!

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of disbelief, like 'you don't say!'
a command to leave, like 'clear off!'

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase serves both as an incredulous 'really?' and as an order to scram.

clue.text: Young Albert has to win the woman completely

parts.note: Al is the short, familiar form of Albert
taken as written
to get is to win or obtain
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: Little Albert must win over the lady, wholly.
explanation.definitionFit: Means wholly or in total, a synonym of entirely.

clue.text: At all events, don't stare so much

definitions.meaning: in any case, nonetheless
read as an instruction to gaze less: regard (stare) less

explanation.definitionFit: Means anyway, whatever happens; split in two it reads as 'look at things less'.

clue.text: Suggestive of Conservatism

definitions.meaning: risque, smutty, as in an off-colour joke
the colour of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.definitionFit: The colour means risque humour and is also the British Tory party colour.

clue.text: Stupid argument intended to catch out a striker

definitions.text: intended to catch out a striker

parts.note: silly means stupid
a point is an argument made in debate

explanation.surface: A foolish line of reasoning designed to trip up someone on strike.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket this is a close fielding position near the batsman (the striker), placed to snap up catches.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket fielder stationed very near the batter, there to take catches off defensive strokes.

clue.text: Staggering along to a country in Africa

indicators.note: staggering is lurching about unsteadily, so the letters are knocked out of order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Lurching along on a journey to an African country.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation on the south-west coast of Africa, capital Luanda.

clue.text: Standard award for sporting prowess

definitions.meaning: a flag or banner, as in a regiment's flag
a badge or cap awarded to a team member in school or university sport

explanation.definitionFit: A regiment's flag is called this, and so is the honour given to a player chosen for a school team.

clue.text: A cut above the other ranks

definitions.meaning: a percentage taken by an agent on a sale
an officer's warrant, which raises the holder above non-officers

explanation.definitionFit: An agent's percentage fee, and the officer's rank granted by warrant over enlisted soldiers.

clue.text: O Valentine!

parts.note: the letter O stands for nil, which in tennis is love, and a Valentine is a romantic note

explanation.definitionFit: A Valentine is a romantic note sent to a sweetheart, and O is the letter standing for love, nil in tennis.

clue.text: Tick and tick off

definitions.meaning: credit, as in buying on tick
to scold or criticise

explanation.definitionFit: Credit is put 'on the slate' in a shop, and to criticise harshly is to pan or rebuke.

clue.text: London area where blended teas finish up

indicators.note: blended tea is mixed, so these letters are mixed into a new order

parts.note: to end is to finish up

explanation.surface: Part of London where mixed teas wind up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blended' rearranges TEAS to EAST. The EAST END is the traditionally working-class area of east London.
explanation.definitionFit: The district of London east of the City, home of the Cockney.

clue.text: Regretted caging a bird

indicators.note: caging means the word holds the bird inside it like a cage

explanation.surface: Sorry to have locked up a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A white heron of marshes and shores.

clue.text: Country churchyard poem exemplified in a cathedral

indicators.note: the abbreviation goes inside the city name

parts.note: Ely is the cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
e.g. means for example

explanation.surface: A rural graveyard poem illustrated in a cathedral.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Gray's 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard' is the famous poem being alluded to.
explanation.definitionFit: Gray's famous mournful poem is a lament written in a country churchyard.

clue.text: Propose to sell up and go

definitions.meaning: to put forward a motion in a meeting
to relocate to a new home

explanation.definitionFit: One puts a motion forward in debate, and one changes house when relocating.

clue.text: Enough eel to extract cooking fat

indicators.note: to extract means to pull out letters lying within the two words

explanation.surface: A good amount of eel to render down for fat.
explanation.definitionFit: Clarified butter used in South Asian cooking.

clue.text: Expensive way to marinade

definitions.meaning: ... means overpriced
to soak food in liquid

explanation.definitionFit: A price can be stiff or high, and to soak food in liquid is to souse it.

clue.text: Clever journalist was stung by criticism

parts.note: smart means clever
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A clever reporter felt the sting of a harsh review.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel a sharp sting of hurt, as from a rebuke.

clue.text: Deep in the river it causes a vessel to leak

definitions.meaning: a deep hole worn in a riverbed

definitions.text: it causes a vessel to leak
definitions.meaning: a hole in a pot, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: A deep hollow scoured in a riverbed, and read as two words a breach in a cooking pot.

clue.text: Notoriety of a celebrated hypochondriac

definitions.meaning: a bad reputation
someone famous for being sick, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: Disrepute or bad reputation; split up it is renown for sickness.

clue.text: Near a sign directing hospital visitors

definitions.meaning: approaching, close to
a signpost pointing the way to the patients' rooms

explanation.definitionFit: Means approaching or in the direction of; split, it is a hospital signpost.

clue.text: Stress, in a manner of speaking

definitions.meaning: emphasis on a syllable
a regional way of pronouncing words

explanation.definitionFit: Emphasis placed on a syllable, and a regional or social pronunciation.

clue.text: Model child-minder

definitions.meaning: someone who poses for an artist
a babysitter

explanation.definitionFit: One who poses for a portrait, and short for babysitter.

clue.text: One's masters

definitions.meaning: plural of one, the cards with a single pip
experts, champions

explanation.definitionFit: Playing cards of value one, and experts at something.

clue.text: Sign up Verne's captain

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: an omen is a sign

explanation.surface: Enlist the skipper of the Nautilus.
explanation.definitionFit: Jules Verne's submarine commander in Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea.

clue.text: It measures the speed of a comet colliding with earth

indicators.note: a collision smashes things together, so the two words' letters are jumbled as one

explanation.surface: An instrument recording how fast a comet hits our planet.
explanation.definitionFit: A rev counter, the dial gauging engine rotation rate.

clue.text: Still hasn't paid for a ring with which to marry

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O
to wed is to marry

explanation.surface: A man has yet to settle the bill for the wedding band.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt not yet settled is one that remains due.

clue.text: Post-mortem on Underworld group

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and the underworld itself
a section is a group or division

explanation.surface: An autopsy carried out on a gang of crooks.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting up a body for examination is what an autopsy involves.
